items.title: Infant feeding and mental health support to be rolled out across England by 2028
items.summary: A ‘Healthy Babies’ programme like what used to be provided in Sure Start centres will be rolled out to all local authorities by 2028, the Government has announced.

items.title: Hospitals paid up to ten times more than GPs to monitor adult ADHD patients, LMC claims
items.summary: Exclusive GP leaders in one area have claimed they have been offered ten times less than hospitals to deliver the same ADHD service.

items.title: Willingness to seek help may explain rising mental health demand among young people
items.summary: An increase in demand for GP appointments for mental health issues may be down to a greater willingness among young people to seek help, a study has found. Norwegian researchers said mental health problems have being reported to have risen in many high-income countries, particularly among teens and young adults.

items.title: Majority of GPs think ADHD is ‘overdiagnosed’, suggests Pulse survey
items.summary: Exclusive Seven in 10 GPs think adult ADHD is ‘overdiagnosed’, including nearly half who think it is ‘very overdiagnosed’, a Pulse survey has suggested. More than eight in 10 patients referred to adult ADHD services receive a positive diagnosis, GPs in the survey also estimated.

items.title: ‘Alarming’ rise in children attending A&E in mental health crisis
items.summary: A growing number of children and young people ending up in A&E with mental health concerns because of a lack of alternative options is a ‘national crisis’, the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health (RCPCH) has warned.

items.title: Nurses asked to consult on guidance aimed at improving diagnosis of OCD and BDD
items.summary: Nurses and other healthcare professionals are being asked to consult on draft guidance which aims to improve the identification of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and body dysmorphic disorder (BDD).

items.title: Assess people with depression, anxiety or ADHD for OCD and BDD, NICE recommends
items.summary: GPs should consider assessing people with depression, anxiety or ADHD for signs of obsessive compulsive disorder (OCD) and body dysmorphic disorder (BDD), NICE has recommended.

items.title: GIRFT mental health assessment tool shortlisted for national innovation award
items.summary: An assessment tool used by the GIRFT mental health team to support service improvements has been shortlisted for a national innovation award.

items.title: Costs of autism and ADHD demand ‘unsustainable’, health chiefs warn
items.summary: The costs of meeting the ‘soaring’ demand for autism and ADHD services in England have become ‘unsustainable’, health chiefs have warned.

items.title: Rise in children’s A&E mental health visits prompts call for nurse investment
items.summary: A rise in children and young people (CYP) attending A&E departments with mental health concerns has prompted calls for new and sustained investment in specialist nursing roles.
